name: cog-canvas-benchmark
description:
CogCanvas Benchmark
	

Paper | GitHub
CogCanvas is a training-free framework for maintaining long-term memory in LLM conversations. This repository contains the Controlled Benchmark used to evaluate CogCanvas's ability to extract verbatim-grounded cognitive artifacts and perform temporal and multi-hop reasoning.
